consumer: Qwen3.5-2B FFN normalization and gating, and Qwen GGUF F32 normalization
payload: Two independently resident slots with exact representable input values 0.25 and -0.5; BF16 weight 1.0. This preserves compute shape and complete tensor cost, not downloaded full-model inference.
completion: One accepted tensor operation through terminal Completion wait and destructor; all ggml entry/exit events, conversion, native graph execution and pool work remain charged.
ownership: Independent Context, MemoryResource, Queue, buffers, prepared program and two Invocations on each side; resources are destroyed only after completion. Cold allocation, upload, preparation and warmup outside hot timing, cold elapsed separately reported.
comparability: Ordinary resident operation permits native private scratch, blocking and internal streams. Neither side requests external capture or forbids private allocations. Strict domains are excluded, not withdrawn.
precision: RMS F32 accumulation, epsilon 1e-6; BF16 gate F32 intermediate and one final BF16 rounding. Verify every output element before and after measurement; BF16 absolute tolerance one representable step (0.0078125), F32 2e-5.
scope: Three same-contract pair domains at the declared shape/precision/software/resource identity only. No generic HYLE/ggml/SGLang superiority or full-model throughput claim.
